digest.title: Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package compromised to steal credentials
digest.tldr: Hackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework Python package on PyPI, publishing two malicious versions designed to steal cloud credentials and other sensitive information from developers' systems.

digest.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Compact Desktops Out Now
digest.tldr: New NVIDIA RTX Spark compact desktops from ASUS, Dell and MSI are available today, bringing local AI agents, image and video generation, and model fine-tuning to a dedicated Windows PC.

digest.title: Microsoft AI: Seven new world-class models at scalable price-performance
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
digest.tldr: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

digest.title: British hackers face prison for GTA 6 data breach and crypto thefts
digest.tldr: Two British hackers face lengthy prison sentences for hacks that broke into the Grand Theft Auto gamemaker and for stealing millions in crypto.
